raw_segments.text: Chorus, low, sin by sin and sorrow dogged by sorrow, and who the end can know.
The slayer of today shall die tomorrow, the wage of wrong is woe.
While time shall be, while Zeus in heaven is lord, his law is fixed and stern.
On him that rot shall vengeance be outpoured, the tides of doom return.
The children of the curse abide within these halls of high estate, and none can wrench
from off the home of sin the clinging grasp of fate.
